what: The test split's diagnosis certificates and fee statements on the redrawn statutory forms, as medium-damage page pictures, read by Upstage information-extract (one JSON-schema call per page, no prompt tuning beyond the field descriptions) and by this repository's grid reader; both scored field by field against the generator's values with the same rules. Script scripts/eval-vendor-ocr.py, workflow vendor-ocr-evaluation.

runs.note: stopped before any page: the job ran scripts/setup.py, which needs a database this job does not have

format check on the first four test pages; both vendor misses were diagnosis_name = main disease + the 부 질병 decoy, so the field description was changed to 'main disease only' before the full run (a change made after seeing four test pages)

limitations: Synthetic values on the redrawn statutory forms with simulated damage; not documents a hospital issued. A reader that is right here is not thereby right on real paper.

The vendor sees one page picture and a JSON schema with a one-line description per field; the grid reader knows the form's geometry. They are not the same task, and the comparison says what each gives on these pictures, not which is the better product.
The diagnosis_name description was corrected after four test pages had been seen; the other field descriptions were not touched.
Cost is pages x the assumed 0.04 USD per page; the bill in the vendor console is the real number and was not read from here.
One damage level (medium). light and heavy were not sent.
grid_reader_misses_note: scored with the script's own rule: names compared without spaces, dates and amounts normalised; 6 missing + 9 wrong = 15, matching the summary
